name: @avs/talking-head-overlay
description: Talking-head motion-graphics overlay package (Remotion): composite preview plus transparent ProRes 4444 overlay

scripts.render: remotion render Composite out/talking-head-overlay.mp4 && remotion render Overlay out/talking-head-overlay.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 --pixel-format=yuva444p10le --image-format=png
